Each profile aggregates the available photos, known associations, and contextual background, allowing users to explore how individuals intersect across the wider network. Posts can be viewed, liked, and commented on just like instagram.  The goal of Epstagram is not entertainment, but visibility: to make public records easier to navigate, easier to question, and harder to ignore. Explore the network, connect the dots and join the network. You might even earn yourself an invitation to an island one day.
